latePickup.registeredToastMessage: The system will automatically extend your rental time by exactly the number of hours late once the vehicle is handed over.

latePickup.compensatedBody: The previous trip returned late, so the system has extended your rental time by {{hours}} hours (value {{amount}}). New return time: {{date}}.
latePickup.acceptedBody: You have agreed to wait if the previous trip returns late. Once the vehicle is handed over, the system will automatically extend your rental time by exactly the number of hours late (funded by the previous trip's late-return fee). If the vehicle is still not ready by your pickup time, you can cancel free of charge with a 100% deposit refund.
latePickup.offerBody: The vehicle's previous trip may return late, affecting your pickup time. You can accept the wait — the system will automatically extend your rental time by exactly the number of hours late, funded by the previous trip's late-return fee. If the vehicle is still not ready by your pickup time, you can cancel free of charge with a 100% deposit refund.
latePickup.acceptWait: Accept the wait — rental time auto-compensated
latePickup.acceptModalBody: When you accept the wait: your booking will not be automatically cancelled by the system while you wait, and as soon as the previous trip hands over the vehicle, your return time will be automatically extended by exactly the number of hours late. The cost of the compensated hours comes from the previous trip's late-return fee — you pay nothing extra.
latePickup.acceptModalHint: If the vehicle is still not ready by your pickup time, you can cancel free of charge with a 100% deposit refund.
